profile.headline: Software Engineer | Back-end APIs | AWS | Microservices | App Interfaces | Agile
profile.summary:
I'm a passionate and analytical Software professional with experience in design, development, testing and delivery of back-end microservices and 3rd-party app interfaces. I'm flexible and have worked in agile environments that use both a Kanban style and a two-week sprint style. 

I'm Industry-agnostic, having worked in both Medical and Retail. I'm an expert at working hand-in-hand with product owners to understand workflow and design technical solutions and improvements to whatever their needs.

I'm open to opportunities in the L.A. area, San Diego area, or anything Remote.

My skillset:

•	Languages: Java, Python, PostgreSQL, Oracle SQL, HTML/JavaScript	

•	Development Tools: Maven, Spring-Boot, Django, Airflow, Jenkins, GitHub

•	 AWS Technologies: DynamoDB, Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch	

•	PM Tools: Jira, Confluence, Kanban, Rally

positions.title: AI Data Specialist
positions.description:
Contracting role to train Large Language Models on coding related prompts using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).
•	Prompt different LLMs to update, refactor, debug, and explain supplied code and rate their responses based on criteria I create.
•	Wrote unit tests to verify the generated code, and in some cases wrote my own solutions to supply an idealized response.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with teammates in an agile environment to design, implement, test, and deploy applications using AWS technologies such as EC2, DynamoDB, CodeDeploy, Lambda, and API Gateway. These applications stored large amounts of customer feedback data and were used by multiple stakeholders, such as business analysts, product managers, and data scientists for training models.

Selected Accomplishments:
• Architected and implemented Java-based AWS Lambda moving 100K+ rows of Google Analytics data from BigQuery to Amazon Redshift database for use by business analysts.

• Drastically reduced deployment time of major services switching to blue / green deployment via AWS CodeDeploy and Jenkins after making a proof-of-concept convince managers.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Amazon S3 · RESTful WebServices · Software Design · AWS CodeDeploy · API Gateways · Oracle Database · Collaborative Problem Solving · Jenkins · Amazon Redshift · Information Technology · Git · Java · Big Data · GitHub · Agile Application Development · Cache Management · Spring Boot · Qualtrics · Amazon EC2 · Scrum · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Implemented feature requests from GI doctors and radiologists in both existing software repositories and new ones.
• Innovated Java interface to box.com feeding 20gb+ video files to GI doctors for diagnosing patients remotely. 
• Frequently added features to Java Spring / Hibernate Radiology Information System increasing usability, eliminating bugs, and satisfying client needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Javascript · Maven · Linux Server · RESTful WebServices · HL7 Standards · Debugging Code · Software Design · Subversion · Eclipse · PostgreSQL · Information Technology · Medical Coding · Java · Spring MVC · Requirements Engineering

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Taught a programming lab class which involved teaching students common algorithmic paradigms and helping them code them in java.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithms · Information Technology · Higher Education Teaching · Java · GitHub

projects.title: NHANES Patient Generator
projects.description:
Working hand-in-hand with a physician on medical data analysis in creating a Python API to query and calculate statistics on the CDCs NHANES database and using the above data to generate sample patients for diagnostic training.
Open-source repository available at https://github.com/akhayat/nhanes-patient-generator
